name: Cultural Landscape of Bali Province: the Subak System as a Manifestation of the Tri Hita Karana Philosophy
description: On the Indonesian island of Bali, five clusters of green rice terraces spread across 19,500 hectares, tied together by canals, weirs and water temples. Farmers have shared water through this cooperative subak system since the 9th century, guided by a belief in harmony between gods, people and nature. Visitors can also see Pura Taman Ayun, the island's grandest 18th-century royal water temple.
